newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania's 16 presidential candidates are on their campaign trail across the country ahead of Sunday's presidential and general elections.

* President Ion Iliescu, campaigning in Brasov, told industrial workers confronted with the hardships of daily life to have confidence in the revival of Romanian economy, in answer to protesters at the Tractorul farm equipment plant.
* National Centre Union's presidential candidate Ioan Pop de Popa met representatives of the national council for small and medium-sized entreprises.
* Socialist Party's presidential challenger Tudor Mohora campaigns in the southern Olt county, while National Unity Party leader Gheorghe Funar visited Dej, near the main Transylvanian city of Cluj.
* Eight foreign journalists and 46 foreign observers have been accredited so far for the November 3 elections, the Central Electoral Bureau said.
* Romanian and Hungarian border guards met for annual conference in Oradea, on the border with Hungary.

* Romanian oil drilling company Petromar has started drilling in the Marmara Sea for Turkey. Another platform has drilled 1,000 metres deep in Bulgaria's Black Sea area. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
